items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: it was three trumpets, Bobby Hackett, Clark Terry, and myself.

ctx.x: Arpeggios the same arpeggios. I had to get all of that out of my system. And I was too busy learn- ing, I didn't worry about anyone listening to me, at that time. I was too busy. Bobby Hackett came on the scene, that was another problem. He worked with Cab one night.
